author: agent:claude-code
message: The user's refinement of the accepted lanes design: not a separate crate but a no_std path for autodyne's whole core, done first as its own milestone, with the geometry and lanes as modules over the existing units traits and simd dispatch. (proposal 01a10a6a-cd12-703f-9c31-f6c6f9af5cb6, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

name: no_std core
intent: autodyne builds without std (alloc + libm) for wasm32, everything outside the std-only parts, with both paths built and tested in CI.

name: no_std
intent: One crate, two paths: the default `std` feature as today, and without it core + alloc, float maths through libm in the units traits, compile-time target features in place of runtime CPU detection, and no std-only caches. flux, gpu, linalg (faer) and what builds on it (systems, ode) stay behind std. CI builds the no_std path for wasm32 and runs the tests on both.

text: Outside flux, gpu, linalg, systems and ode, code uses core:: and alloc::, never std:: directly: what needs std (threads, files, time, runtime CPU detection, global caches) sits behind the std feature, with a no_std path beside it.

Small fixed-size geometry, batched kernels over structure-of-arrays data, and portable SIMD lanes, as modules of autodyne written over its units traits and simd dispatch, in its no_std path so other projects (parda-2d first) use them with default-features = false. Built to replace glam and hand-written loops: each piece is adopted when it matches or beats them in benchmarks.

reason: Covered by autodyne / no_std: the whole core gets a no_std path, not a separate lean crate.

text: f32x4, f32x8 and f32x16 on stable Rust (SSE2 / AVX2 / AVX-512 on x86-64, NEON on aarch64, wasm simd128; runtime dispatch with std, compile-time without), with the rasterizer's operations (signed distances, coverage, premultiplied blending) 8 or 16 pixels at a time. Core / simd's kernels move onto them.

title: Publish autodyne to crates.io
body: parda wants it from crates.io under the library combo, used with default-features = false. Publishing is the user's call: name, version, and whether the draft license texts are reviewed first.

title: One crate with a std feature, not a separate no_std crate
body: parda's graft asked for numerics without faer, rustfft, cranelift or cubecl, no_std + alloc, on wasm. A separate small crate below autodyne would have needed its own number traits and dispatch, two owners of the same facts. Instead autodyne's core gets a no_std path (the user's call): one Float / Real, one simd dispatch, and the DSP modules usable on wasm too, at the cost of a wide mechanical refactor done first (milestone no_std core). Starting point measured: almost all std:: uses outside flux are ops / fmt that are core:: already; the real std dependencies are runtime CPU detection, a few caches and once-cells, and float maths (mostly through the units traits, so libm there covers most callers).
